Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Cross-fade transition marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe 交叉淡化过渡 in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary — lead with 交叉淡化过渡

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 交叉淡化过渡 and 优先交叉淡化 for Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions under 辅助功能 → 动作. Related commerce phrasing includes 交叉淡化, 淡化过渡, and 渐隐过渡 when your gallery shows Settings captures or Motion-menu context. Avoid literal inventions like 交叉渐变 that sound like gradient effects, or bleed from Reduce Motion's 减少动态效果. English listings say "Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions" or "Cross-fade instead of slide/zoom"; zh-Hans storefront copy should use 交叉淡化过渡 and context-appropriate transition vocabulary.

Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions vs Reduce Motion — do not conflate

Reduce Motion tones down animations, parallax, and zoom transitions globally across the UI — 减少动态效果. Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions specifically replaces slide and zoom UI transitions with cross-fade dissolve effects — 交叉淡化过渡. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply global animation reduction when your English source only markets cross-fade transition style — and should not upgrade Reduce Motion badges to cross-fade claims unless that is what the frame shows.

Cross-fade transitions vs video preview autoplay — do not conflate

Auto-Play Video Previews controls whether short video previews autoplay in system surfaces — 自动播放视频预览. Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions controls how UI pages and controls transition — 交叉淡化过渡. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply video preview autoplay when your English source only markets cross-fade navigation — and should not upgrade preview-autoplay badges to transition-style claims unless that is what the frame shows.

Cross-fade transitions vs video flash dimming — do not conflate

Dim Flashing Lights dims detected flash and strobe patterns in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions changes UI transition animation style — 交叉淡化过渡. Different toggles, different screenshot vocabulary — do not merge flash-dimming and cross-fade transition claims in one subtitle line.

No motion-sickness or medical claims

US marketing sometimes mentions animation sensitivity alongside transition toggles. zh-Hans listing copy should describe system cross-fade transition behavior and compatibility — not medical treatment, vestibular therapy, or guarantees that transitions are safe for all users. AppLocale rewrites storefront language aligned with Apple's Motion accessibility preference; we do not write health claims.

Listing text vs re-shooting transition comparison galleries

You can describe Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions accurately in zh-Hans description, subtitle, and overlay lines without re-exporting every before/after slide-vs-dissolve frame. If your English gallery already shows transition comparison pairs, send those overlay strings and we localize them. AppLocale does not shoot, design, or re-export screenshots.

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need transition-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 交叉淡化过渡, 优先交叉淡化, and 交叉淡化 each signal different intent from generic accessibility or animation keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Motion or transition demos — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. AppLocale FAQ

Is Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions the same as Reduce Motion?

No. Reduce Motion covers toned-down animations and motion-sensitive UI reduction globally — 减少动态效果. Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions covers the separate Motion toggle that replaces slide and zoom UI transitions with cross-fade dissolve effects — 交叉淡化过渡. See our Reduce Motion listing guide only if global animation reduction is your lead marketing claim.

Is Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions the same as Auto-Play Video Previews or Dim Flashing Lights?

No. Auto-Play Video Previews covers video preview autoplay — 自动播放视频预览. Dim Flashing Lights dims detected flash and strobe patterns in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions covers cross-fade instead of slide or zoom UI transitions — 交叉淡化过渡. Different toggles, different screenshot vocabulary.

Where is Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions in Settings?

English iOS path: Settings → Accessibility → Motion → Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions. Apple's zh-Hans Settings vocabulary: 交叉淡化过渡 and 优先交叉淡化 under 辅助功能 → 动作. Mention both paths honestly when your gallery shows Settings captures.

Can zh-Hans copy claim motion-sickness treatment?

No. Listing copy should describe system cross-fade transition compatibility and UI transition behavior — not medical treatment, diagnosis, or guarantees that transitions are safe for all users.
